item.title: Its Official! 12 Teams in the College Football Playoff From Next Year
item.description: The management committee of the College Football Playoff declared on Friday that the 2026 field will still consist of 12 teams. The decision gives the CFP and conference commissioners more time to think about expanding the playoffs to a potential 16- or 24-team format in the future. At this point, the Big Ten and SEC are at odds over the playoff’s immediate direction.
